title: Stop Saying "I Want Revenge" (Part 2) #shorts
description:
Part 2: 3 more ways to say "I want revenge". Your neighbour smashed your car. You don't just want revenge:
• Get back at someone: do something bad to someone who hurt you. (He smashed my car, so I want to get back at him.)
• Hit back: answer an attack with an attack. (They broke our window, so we hit back.)
• Have the last laugh (idiom): win in the end, after others laughed at you. (They laughed at my old car, but I had the last laugh.)

Would you hit back, or walk away?

Missed Part 1? Watch it here: https://youtube.com/shorts/2ozeoc1cv4Y
